briefdescription.para: Doxygen module entry point for ThemisDB storage components.

detaileddescription.para: The storage module contains the persistence, backup, recovery, WAL, MVCC, compaction, and storage-integrity surfaces that back ThemisDB runtime data management. Module-adjacent design and planning documents live in src/storage/README.md, src/storage/ARCHITECTURE.md, src/storage/ROADMAP.md, and src/storage/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md.
